openingLine: Timur replaced my module without asking. I want to leave this team.

turns.text: You're right to be angry. Walk me through it.
turns.characterLine: How do I know this will not happen again?

turns.text: It won't happen again, I promise.
turns.characterLine: What is your concrete plan for the demo?
The Thursday run failed. What now?
I cannot agree to work without a limit. We need another plan.
